span.normalized: Our product offerings are predominantly manufactured in our own facilities, located in the U.S. and internationally, using our proprietary process technologies. In recent years, however, we have also strategically utilized third-party foundry manufacturing capacity, including at one of our key foundry competitors, TSMC, for various tiles or an entire product where advantageous for cost, performance, schedule or other considerations. This approach provides flexibility and scale, including in recent years the ability to offer products at the most performant end of the spectrum where comparable internal process technologies were not yet available.
